verdict.rationale: Anytype ships native iOS and Android apps that sync with desktop, and hands-on users describe them as well-crafted and working well. However, nothing in the evidence shows that capture, search, and linking on mobile match desktop, so the 'not a stripped-down companion' part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: documented mobile feature parity for capture/search/linking, explicit statement that mobile holds the whole knowledge base, independent power-user corroboration of mobile depth (the one user cited uses it as a basic note system).
